evidence.claim: The N+1 problem occurs because ORMs use lazy loading, which defers fetching related entities until they are accessed, causing a separate query per parent when accessed in a loop.
evidence.quote: The root cause of the N+1 problem is lazy loading, a default behavior in most ORMs.

evidence.claim: The N+1 problem occurs when an ORM executes an excessive number of database queries to fetch related entities, specifically N additional queries for each parent, resulting in 1 + N total queries.
